page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s3 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core, indicating that hyperthreading is disabled. It is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. There are no integrated GPUs or hardware accelerators present on this instance. Additionally, the instance does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Hardware-level instruction set extensions such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA) are not enabled on this instance. Due to the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the instance is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not require specialized vector instructions or large memory footprints. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, basic computational tasks, and distributed microservices that operate within the 8.0 GB memory boundary.
